excluded_non_runtime_paths.reason: The evaluation package consumes runtime surfaces but is not imported by the runtime layer. Evaluation and Gauntlet machinery may evolve without relabeling the frozen Runtime Baseline v1 implementation as changed.

notes: This companion does not alter reports/runtime/baseline-v1.json or Runtime Baseline v1 claims.
The boundary exists so qualification workflows distinguish frozen runtime implementation from benchmark/evaluation machinery in the same installable package.

Only the evaluation package is excluded. Harness, API, core, memory, runtime, state, package metadata, profiles, schemas, aliases, and other package surfaces remain protected unless a future reviewed boundary revision explicitly classifies them otherwise.
